*Sanidassanattika, Kilesadukādi* is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* within the Pali Tipiṭaka. In the combinatorial matrix of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text treats conditional relations by combining the *Sanidassanattika* (the triad on states that are visible and impingent, invisible and impingent, or invisible and non-impingent) with the *Kilesadukādi* (the dyads beginning with the defilements, *kilesa*).
